title.vi: Sắc lệnh Khu vực được bảo vệ năm 2024
title.th: คำสั่งสถานที่ที่ได้รับการคุ้มครอง พ.ศ. 2567

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-48-2024-PROTECTED-PLACES-ORDER-2024.pdf》（3 页），本次切分 3 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Order may be cited as the Protected Places Order, 2024 and shall commence on the date it is made.

The place specified in the first column of the Schedule, which is more particularly described in the plan specified in the second column thereof deposited in the office of the Surveyor-General, is hereby declared to be a protected place for the purposes of the Act. Authority

The authority specified in the third column of the Schedule is from whom permission to enter the protected place is to be received.

SCHEDULE (paragraphs 2 and 3) Place Plan Number Authority Building and area 16317 Director of Internal Detention and Rehabilitation Unit Security. Internal Security Department Simpang 1111, Jalan Tutong Kampong Sinaut Mukim Keriam Tutong District Made this 7th. day of Jamadilakhir, 1446 Hijriah corresponding to the 9th. day of December, 2024.

DATO SERI SETIA A WANG HAJI AHMADDIN BIN HAJI ABDUL RAHMAN Minister of Home Affairs.
